FN-6Y5BNZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 245
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 245 as introduced could decrease public utilities license tax receipts to the State
General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of non-refundable,
non-transferable tax credits, claimed beginning in Fiscal year 2027 for donations to certain rural
hospitals to be used for certain allowable expenditures, as provided by this bill.
Under current law, the cumulative amount of tax credits offered under the Rural Hospital
Investment Program can not exceed $20 million in tax year 2026, $25 million in tax year 2027,
and $30 million in tax year 2028 and every year thereafter.
